title: UpdaterItems
description: UpdaterItems automatically updates obsolete items, ensuring a better experience on your server.

🤓 **¿What is UpdaterItems?**
> UpdaterItems is a plugin that automatically updates outdated items on your server. Say goodbye to problems with old items and provide your players with a smoother experience without the need for manual updates or outdated methods. With a simple and intuitive configuration, UpdaterItems takes care of everything efficiently for you.

📄 **Features**
- Updating obsolete items
- Bypass for skip check
- Very low performance impact
- Enabled and disabled the updater
- Item update log in console
- Easy to use

📌 **¿How do you use UpdaterItems?**

Create a new Updater with the item you need to update in hand, 
```
/ui create “name”
```
Then set the item you want to update, hold it in your hand, and use 
```
/ui set “name” new
```
And you're done. Players in events such as PlayerJoin and OpenInventory will see the item updated! (And set some conditions in the config.yml)

**Need help?** Don't hesitate to enter the [discord](https://discord.com/invite/nQAukFUkMq)

Information on permissions, commands, etc, in our [wiki](https://wiki-or-t2h-team.gitbook.io/wiki-t2hstudio/updateritems/about)
